figures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 original editorial science cover, wide 1536 by 864 composition. A precise but poetic paper-cut relief about choosing the structure and target of a quantum dynamics calculation. Compose two independent abstract arrangements on one warm ivory sheet with generous negative space, with no connecting arrow. On the left, a single broad deep-forest-green curved paper arc is accompanied by several very small ochre curved slivers, showing a dominant evolution term with weak corrections; they belong to the same turning geometry without becoming a physical clock or gear. On the right, a fan of fine charcoal ink traces is seen through one narrow obliquely oriented paper aperture; the opening highlights only the traces aligned with its chosen direction, evoking a target observable. Both arrangements equally important, separated visibly and not drawn as sequential stages or multiplied speedups. Tactile layered cut paper and restrained ink engraving, crisp shadows, ivory charcoal forest green and ochre, sophisticated scientific magazine art, clear silhouettes at thumbnail size. No written text, labels, equations, numbers, graphs, axes, actual circuits, laboratory devices, computers, robots, brains, cosmic imagery, neon or logos. The artwork is a conceptual analogy, not a literal algorithm, measured performance or hardware.
figures.caption_ko: 큰 호와 작은 조각은 해밀토니안 항의 규모 차이를, 방향을 고르는 틈은 목표 관측량을 상징한다. 두 설계 변수를 나란히 놓은 AI 생성 개념 그림이며 실제 회로·계산 결과가 아니다.
figures.caption_en: A broad arc with small slivers evokes unequal Hamiltonian terms; an oriented aperture evokes a target observable. The two design choices are shown side by side in an AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an actual circuit or calculation result.
figures.alt_ko: 아이보리 종이 위 왼쪽에는 큰 녹색 호와 작은 황토색 조각들이 있고, 오른쪽에는 비스듬한 좁은 틈으로 보이는 가는 선 묶음이 놓여 있다.
figures.alt_en: A broad green arc and small ochre slivers on the left of ivory paper; on the right, fine traces are viewed through a narrow tilted aperture.
